title: Oozy Creamy Mexican Beef Birria
description: A winey and creamy Mexican dish featuring Persian cucumber, this quick-fix birria is diabetic-friendly and perfect for a weeknight dinner. The namul-blanch-season method adds a burst of flavor to the dish.
instructions: Heat a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat and add the chopped onion to cook until browned.
Add the beef brisket pieces to the pot and cook until browned on all sides.
Add the sliced Persian cucumber to the pot and cook for 2 minutes.
Add the tomato paste, beef broth, red wine, cumin, salt, and black pepper to the pot and stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 1 hour.
Use two forks to shred the beef into bite-sized pieces.
Stir in the cream and continue to simmer for an additional 10 minutes.
Serve the birria hot, garnished with additional sliced Persian cucumber if desired.
